## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` pass.
- [ ] A change to exposure, confirmation, execution, or schema handling names the threat from `documentation/security.md` that it covers and includes security tests.
- [ ] A changed design decision updates `documentation/architecture.md`.
- [ ] Markdown changes follow the "Writing documentation" section of `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
